workshoptitle: Build Connected Transportation Solutions with Oracle Autonomous AI Database

tutorials.title: Getting Started
tutorials.description: Launch the environment and open Database Actions SQL Worksheet.

tutorials.title: Lab 1: Build a Converged Fleet Operations Query
tutorials.description: Connect service risk, semantic signals, shipment orders, and terminal geography.

tutorials.description: Help Thomas choose between native JSON columns, JSON collections, and JSON-Relational Duality Views for a shipment application.

tutorials.title: Lab 3: Review a Semantic Disruption Search
tutorials.description: Use in-database embeddings to rank disruption and demand evidence by meaning.

tutorials.title: Lab 6: Evaluate a Service Demand-Surge Prototype with Oracle Machine Learning for SQL

tutorials.title: Lab 7: Ask Transportation Questions with Select AI
tutorials.description: Turn natural-language transportation questions into SQL that can be inspected and run.

tutorials.title: Lab 8: Build a Transportation Operations Agent with Select AI Agent
tutorials.description: Create a read-only operations agent that uses an approved SQL tool.

tutorials.title: Lab 9: Final Quiz
tutorials.description: Check your understanding with scored questions.
